name: NCDR_EPDIV3_FELLOWS_TRAIN
description: This table contains information from the Follows in Training under the Procedure section in the NCDR EP Deivce Registry v3.0.

columns.name: REGISTRY_DATA_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the registry data record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: FELLOW_PROV_ID_PROV_NAME
columns.description: The name of the service provider. This item may be hidden in a public view of the CLARITY_SER table.

columns.name: PROGRAM_IDENT
columns.description: Indicate the institution's Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) number for the program in which the Fellow is participating.
